items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I thought Teo had the Norella that was born and raised here myself.

ctx.x: I heard they came from Mexico, but I guess they didn't.
I know when I was a young man, they used to be right there on Main Street, you know. Uh-huh. And I thought Teo had the Norella that was born and raised here myself.

Probably was. Yeah, I don't know. That's a Spanish name, you know. Maybe his people came from Mexico. Uh-huh. They might have, that's right. Or he might have gone back there to study for a year or something. Sure. And you never know. He did. He was a great musician. Come here. Here we go. Here's Harold. He didn't have it by him. Hello, can I have him? He's just telling us. Uh, this is Harold, Adrian. Remember who that? How do you feel? How you feeling? I'm fine, I'm fine too. It's fine, my boss. Uh, I wanna, uh,…
